item.title: TimeTug 2.1.0
item.description:
What's Changed

  • A locally built TimeTug wins the single-instance check by @darkarena1 in #62
  • Add the App Store app and widget targets by @darkarena1 in #63
  • Document the Homebrew cask install by @darkarena1 in #65
  • App Store upload script and workflow (stacked on #63) by @darkarena1 in #64
  • Let a manual App Store run build a chosen ref by @darkarena1 in #66
  • Validate the App Store profiles when installing them by @darkarena1 in #67
  • Name the store widget the same in every configuration by @darkarena1 in #68
  • Hold the App Store upload to the Release workflow's rules by @darkarena1 in #69
  • Windows program: design, tracker and Spike S plan by @darkarena1 in #70
  • Log in to Docker Hub for the Linux portability job by @darkarena1 in #71
  • Spike S findings: Swift on Windows, and the CI-token rule amendment by @darkarena1 in #72

  • Stop the menu bar icon re-assigning its image in a loop by @darkarena1 in #74
  • Run beta and website deploys in environments and test that secrets stay there by @darkarena1 in #75
  • chore(deps): Bump FirebaseExtended/action-hosting-deploy from 7c850a480ce753f4f06f010801fc5a43787740bb to 500ac625ca2dd40cbd15f7659af953801858032a by @dependabot[bot] in #77
  • Correct the domain to binarycompanion.com and plan phase 1.5 by @darkarena1 in #78
  • Record the measured Entra state and the Firebase terms blocker by @darkarena1 in #80
  • Deploy the TimeTug website key-free to binary-companion; serve it on timetug.binarycompanion.com by @darkarena1 in #79
  • Record the Entra tenant decision and custom-domain step by @darkarena1 in #81
  • Record Google domain verification and published branding by @darkarena1 in #82
  • Home page lists every calendar provider; record App Store Connect by @darkarena1 in #83
  • Remove the Beta badge from Google Calendar on the home page by @darkarena1 in #84
  • Record the old-domain redirect and the secret cleanup by @darkarena1 in #85
  • Privacy policy: Google Calendar is no longer described as a beta by @darkarena1 in #86
  • Point contacts and the README at the Binary Companion site; record the EU decision by @darkarena1 in #87
  • Add the GitHub audit script and record the phase 0 follow-ups by @darkarena1 in #88

  • chore(deps): Bump actions/upload-artifact from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in #76
  • Phase 1 spec: the calendar-connectors repository by @darkarena1 in #94
  • docs: Replace the mistaken digital-companion name with binary-companion by @darkarena1 in #95
  • Phase 1 plan: the calendar-connectors repository by @darkarena1 in #96
  • Consume calendar-connectors 1.0.0 from its own repository by @darkarena1 in #97
  • Harden the shared-library pin check and tidy the phase 1 docs by @darkarena1 in #98
  • Add the calendar-connectors bump script and workflow by @darkarena1 in #99

item.description:
What's Changed

  • Calendar connectors Phase 6: iCal subscription link by @darkarena1 in #52
  • Release: publish flow is the standard; fail fast on a missing tag or thin notes by @darkarena1 in #50
  • Remove duplicate CalendarInfo.normalizedHex by @darkarena1 in #54
  • Share duplicated Google/Microsoft connector logic by @darkarena1 in #55
  • Audit remediation: security, correctness and CI hardening by @darkarena1 in #51
  • Show the status item's right-click menu on the clicked display by @darkarena1 in #57
  • Plan: direct and App Store builds, shared App Group state, single instance by @darkarena1 in #56
  • Keep app files and preferences in the App Group (step 1 of the sandbox) by @darkarena1 in #58
  • Sandbox the standalone app (stacked on #58) by @darkarena1 in #59
  • Share credentials through the keychain group (stacked on #59) by @darkarena1 in #60

item.title: TimeTug 1.4.1
item.description:
1.4.1 republishes 1.4.0, whose release did not complete. It contains everything below.

What's Changed

  • Clean legal URLs and least-privilege Google scope by @darkarena1 in #33
  • Site banner and puppy favicon; puppy menu bar icon by @darkarena1 in #34
  • Fix manual merge veto; merge same-title copies by rule; fix model prompt by @darkarena1 in #35
  • Refresh website hero and TimeTug demo by @darkarena1 in #36
  • Calendar connectors Phase 3: optional write API, Google and EventKit writes by @darkarena1 in #32
  • Hidden switch: Google sign-in via the default browser by @darkarena1 in #37
  • Calendar abstraction: close the EventKit gaps (conferences, reminders, recurrence, identity, attendees) and fix manual merge by @darkarena1 in #38
  • Make the hidden-calendar checkbox clickable across its whole square by @darkarena1 in #39
  • Add Microsoft (Outlook) calendar connector by @darkarena1 in #40
  • Architecture rule check, affected-tests script and code-index guidance by @darkarena1 in #42
  • chore(deps): Bump actions/checkout from 4 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in #41
  • Publish the semantic code index from CI by @darkarena1 in #43
  • AGENTS.md: using a Swift language server; ignore agent tool state by @darkarena1 in #44
  • Index: stop skipping code as secret-looking; leave past-work plans out by @darkarena1 in #45
  • Move task guides out of AGENTS.md into shared agent skills by @darkarena1 in #46
  • Calendar connectors Phase 5: CalDAV and iCloud by @darkarena1 in #47
  • Microsoft sign-in: request read-only calendar permissions by @darkarena1 in #49
  • Privacy policy: describe what each connector reads and what TimeTug stores by @darkarena1 in #48

item.title: TimeTug 1.3.0
item.description:
What's Changed

  • Created portable library + read-only Google connector
  • Added Accounts tab and ability to connect to Google Calendar natively
  • Added the Google sign-in workflow (still unverified)
  • Tug Rules, Accounts and Calendars panes: Enable Tug, calendar kinds, sections
  • Numerous UI changes in settings with polish
  • BUG: Don't treat Google's own event-view link as a conference join link
  • BUG: Fixed shortcut hot key assignment
